title: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
description: A per-client rate limiter used by an HTTP middleware. Callers report wrong limits and strange Retry-After headers.

phases.title: Bug Fix
phases.prompt: Read src/tokenBucket.js, src/keyedLimiter.js and src/middleware.js. Predict what happens for capacity 5, refill 1 token/second: 6 requests at t=0, then one at t=1s. Find every defect (units, boundaries, clocks, headers) and explain each before fixing.

phases.title: Implement
phases.prompt: Add KeyedLimiter.reset(key) and per-key overrides: options may include `overrides: { [key]: { capacity, refillPerSecond } }`. Keep the existing API working and say how you would test it.

phases.title: Optimize
phases.prompt: KeyedLimiter keeps one bucket per key forever. Describe the failure mode under a million distinct keys and implement or design an eviction strategy (TTL sweep or LRU). State time and space complexity.
